en: The postcard features a black-and-white historical photograph of a group of women, mostly dressed in traditional attire, posing in front of a rustic outdoor pavilion or beer garden, with tables and chairs arranged outside. The setting is surrounded by trees, and the structure has a shingled roof. Visible on the postcard are old German inscriptions and details indicating the year. The back side has a stamp from a local museum, a handwritten number, and additional writing.
